name: Holt Thunderhorn
summary: On Hunter Rise in Thunder Bluff, Holt Thunderhorn trains tauren hunters for the Horde. He teaches tracking and survival, and points hunters toward specialized trials across Mulgore and beyond.

sections.title: Master of the Rise
sections.body: Holt Thunderhorn trains hunters for the Horde on Hunter Rise, above the plains of Mulgore. He teaches ranged combat, tracking, and survival. Like other elders of his craft, he guides young tauren as they move from roaming hunters to disciplined defenders of their new capital.

faq.q: Where can Holt Thunderhorn be found?
faq.answer: Holt Thunderhorn can be found on Hunter Rise, the southeastern plateau in Thunder Bluff, the tauren capital in Mulgore.
Holt Thunderhorn is a hunter trainer who teaches marksmanship, wilderness survival, and beast taming. He also directs novice hunters to specialized beast mastery trials.

faq.q: What role do hunters hold in Thunder Bluff?
faq.answer: Hunters are the traditional backbone of tauren society. They provide food, patrol the borders against centaur raiding parties, and honor the Earth Mother through balanced, reverent tracking.

angles.text: As a hunter, you can look to Holt Thunderhorn as a central mentor in Thunder Bluff. He teaches weapon techniques and tracking, and refers hunters to beast taming.
As a tauren, you inherit a hunting culture that fed and protected the nomadic tribes long before they made a permanent home atop the bluffs. Holt Thunderhorn carries on that tradition on Hunter Rise.
